query:
select source, count(*) as "documents!",
                  (array_agg(api_key_id order by modified_at desc nulls last)
                       filter (where api_key_id is not null))[1] as api_key_id
           from documents
           where user_id = $1
             and ($2::text[] is null or exists (
                  select 1 from unnest($2::text[]) root where source_covers(root, source)))
           group by source
           order by 2 desc, 1
